text:
Sam (CS): Drafted a compact "Quick Health + Warmup" one-pager for small-mid accounts who hit renewal flags. Wants quick checks (prefill, batch, stream) + CSM-ready copy.

Ivy (SE): paste it here pls

Sam (CS): Pasting the in-doc checklist: micro-prefill (2 runs, 60s apart), client batching (80ms or 6 req), streaming fallback policy (auto-route non-stream when errors spike).

Marco (SRE): For low-volume tenants: prefill TTL=900s, concurrent prefetches <=2. For mid-volume use TTL=1800s and concurrency<=4.

Dana (PM): Can we include a single curl and a small JS batching snippet so CSMs can copy/paste? PM wants simple reproducible steps.

Sam (CS): Curl for CSMs (safe example):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-7b","prompt":"[warmup] prime","max_tokens":6}'
```

Ivy (SE): Client-side batching snippet:
```js
// batch collector
let buf = []
function enqueue(req){ buf.push(req)
  if(buf.length>=6) flush()
  else setTimeout(flush, 80)
}
function flush(){ /* send batch */ buf = [] }
```

Marco (SRE): Observability: emit metrics `cs.prefill.attempt`, `cs.prefill.success`, `cs.batch.flush_size`, `cs.stream.fallback_count`. Tag: tenant_id, route, model_ver. Alerts: prefill.fail_rate >5% for 10m; stream.fallback p50 >500ms for 5m.

Sam (CS): Renewal-risk signals to show on healthcard: 1) prefill failures >3 in 72h, 2) stream.fallback >2/day, 3) batch flush success drop >20% W/W.

Dana (PM): Add a short customer note template for fallback events. Keep it friendly and clear.

Sam (CS): Customer fallback note (short):
"Hi — we detected streaming instability and have temporarily routed your workspace to a stable, non-streaming mode to keep responses reliable. No action needed; well follow up within 1 hour. Reply if youd like a quick test command to run."

Ivy (SE): Troubleshooting steps for CSMs: 1) confirm API key scope 2) run curl and paste raw response 3) attach last 3 sanitized logs. Provide sample logs below.

Marco (SRE): Sample sanitized logs:
```log
[2026-06-01T10:12:01Z] tenant=acme prefill=ok ttl=900 backend=g2
[2026-06-01T10:12:02Z] tenant=acme batch=flush size=5 latency_ms=92 route=prefer_latency
[2026-06-01T10:14:05Z] tenant=acme stream=fallback reason=kv_miss count=1
```

Sam (CS): Playbook step for yellow renewal risk: schedule a 30m enablement session and offer a 1-hour warmup (engineer-assisted). Add suggested calendar text and checklist to the doc.

Dana (PM): Sounds good. Can we add small mobile guidance: increase batch window to 150ms on mobile to save battery?

Ivy (SE): Yep — mark mobile-specific. Also advise prefer_latency for chat flows, prefer_cost for background batch jobs.

cs-bot: Reminder: cs-weekly-review at 16:00 UTC includes this doc.

Sam (CS): Thanks all — Ill fold edits into the one-pager and send to the CSM cohort after the cs-weekly. Closing unless anyone has urgent changes.

Ivy (SE): No urgent edits.

Marco (SRE): Dashboard tile ETA: staging tonight, prod tomorrow morning.

Dana (PM): No further notes.
